agent_reliability.basis: per trial, from the browser and request records: HTTP errors and failed actions (dead ends), whether the trial still ended with an answer, partial and empty answers, trials at or within one request of the limit, and model-output recovery by the protocol parser

coverage.basis: the frozen suite's own coverage record (Stage A), with its targets and gaps exactly as frozen; personas and journeys are SYNTHETIC - illustrative assumptions for a fictional college; not customer research

context.business: Larkspur Community College (fictional): evening and weekend short courses for adults at two campuses.
goals: Help adults find a course that fits their budget, schedule and level without phoning the office.
Fill places in courses with seats left before the term starts.
Make fees, duration and level easy to compare across courses.
Reduce enquiries about refunds and concessions.

journeys.name: Find a course on a day or campus that fits
Find a course at the right level
Check that places are still available
Judge the time commitment and what to bring

context.label: SYNTHETIC - illustrative assumptions for a fictional college; not customer research

personas.constraints: beginner level; moderate budget; prefers courses that include materials
personas.name: Career switcher
personas.needs: a practical first course in a new field; works weekdays, so the class day matters

personas.constraints: low budget; flexible on day; short duration preferred
personas.name: Recent graduate
personas.needs: an affordable course to add a skill to a CV

personas.constraints: fee is the deciding factor; may hold a concession card
personas.name: Budget-conscious learner
personas.needs: the cheapest suitable option and certainty about refunds

personas.constraints: level above beginner; specific campus or day; wants to know seats are available
personas.name: Professional upskiller
personas.needs: an intermediate or advanced course that fits around work

context.weights_note: Journey weights are illustrative priorities chosen for the experiment, not measured traffic or demand.

evidence_quality.basis: the recorded evidence rule: an answer is evidence-supported only if the pages holding it were shown to the agent; counts only (the required pages name answer items)

prospective_rule.status: prospective evidence rule; the recorded (official) evidence rule is unchanged

information_accessibility.basis: measured from each variant's frozen snapshot: on how many listing cards and item pages each fact is stated; per task, where the facts its question depends on are placed

navigation_efficiency.basis: model requests, agent steps, page views and wall time per trial; revisits = returns to a page already visited (consecutive steps on one page count once)

task_success.basis: per completed trial; official = grader v1 as recorded; grader v2 is a labelled post-hoc rescore; prospective rules are shown, never applied

graders.post_hoc: grader v2 (generated-criteria v2), labelled post-hoc rescore

prospective.status: prospective review rule; never applied to official (v1) or recorded post-hoc (v2) grades
